usageNotes: Use this to inspect the current configuration of a specific network interface on a Proxmox node — useful for auditing interface type (bridge, bond, VLAN, etc.) and its addressing method before making changes. Requires `Sys.Audit` on `/nodes/{node}`, so API tokens with read-only audit scope work here. Returns the persisted config from `/etc/network/interfaces`, not live runtime state, so it may differ from what `ip addr` shows if pending changes have not been applied.

examples.summary: Read configuration of the primary bridge interface on node pve1

tips: The response reflects the on-disk network config, not live kernel state — use a system call or SSH to check runtime state if needed.
Interface name must be 2–20 characters; common names include vmbr0, bond0, eth0, ens18, vlan100.
To see all interfaces at once, use the list endpoint (GET /nodes/{node}/network) before drilling into a specific iface.
